title: MVP1 phase-aware constraint matrix for Lausanne/VD parcel intake
scope: Pilot matrix for parcel-driven constraints, envelope, permit handoff, and downstream responsibility signals.

phase_model.source: SIA 112:2014 / SIA 102 practice, with pre-SIA intake phase 0
phase_model.notes: Phase 0 is an Aedifica intake extension. Codes 11-63 follow the Swiss SIA backbone used in docs/strategy/architect-reality.md.

phases.label: Definition du projet, etude de faisabilite

constraints.title: Regulatory route must scope claims to Federal + VD + Lausanne

phase_applicability.action: Resolve project country, canton, and commune before rendering regulatory claims.
Carry selected route into needs analysis and feasibility context.

constraints.title: Parcel identity, EGRID, official area, and RDPPF extract are required

phase_applicability.action: Fetch and store parcel identity before constraint calculation.
Recheck identity when feasibility scenarios use parcel area or geometry.
Use the verified parcel identity in permit dossier references.

constraints.title: OEREB zoning label must be mapped to a commune ruleset zone

phase_applicability.action: Resolve commune zone or mark envelope as unknown.
Use the matched zone to test feasibility and massing limits.
Confirm the zone match against the plan before design commitment.
Cite the matched zone and source locator in permit notes.

constraints.title: Centre historique envelope is governed by geometric context, not a fixed IUS/IBUS

phase_applicability.action: Do not compute a numeric SBP max from IUS/IBUS; use gabarit context.
Review contiguous buildings, cornice line, roof gabarit, and depth before concept freeze.
Coordinate architectural massing with geometric constraints.
Expose the geometric-rule basis in the authorization dossier.

constraints.title: Noise sensitivity degree affects use, acoustic risk, and permit checks

phase_applicability.action: Flag noise sensitivity in the feasibility brief.
Coordinate acoustic requirements with the project concept when use or exposure requires it.
Include acoustic justification if the permit dossier requires it.
Retain acoustic evidence for commissioning if acoustic performance was a project requirement.

constraints.title: Construction alignment is present and must be confirmed before design commitment

source_refs.locator: Limite des constructions definie par un plan approuve

phase_applicability.action: Flag alignment in unknowns and risk list.
Confirm precise line before relying on envelope.
Check concept against the alignment.
Include alignment compliance evidence in authorization if required.
Carry confirmed line into execution drawings.
Use confirmed setting-out data before site execution.

constraints.title: Land-register servitudes are not available through the free pilot pipeline

phase_applicability.action: Mark servitudes as unknown before feasibility conclusions.
Request land-register verification before committing to envelope or access assumptions.
Confirm servitude impacts before concept freeze.
Carry relevant servitude evidence into permit dossier if needed.

constraints.title: Phase 33 needs a source-backed dossier completeness checklist

phase_applicability.action: Collect expected permit documents before phase 33.
Prepare calculations, plans, notices, and justifications for authorization.
Run dossier completeness check before filing.

constraints.title: Energy, fire, accessibility, and seismic gates must become explicit checks

phase_applicability.action: Flag mandatory compliance families early.
Coordinate specialist evidence before authorization.
Block permit-readiness if mandatory compliance evidence is missing.
Carry approved compliance assumptions into execution project.
Track execution changes that could invalidate compliance evidence.
Retain commissioning evidence where required.

constraints.title: Every phase handoff must carry decisions, assumptions, unknowns, and approvals

phase_applicability.action: Create initial decision and unknowns ledger.
Carry feasibility assumptions into preliminary studies.
Record concept decisions and unresolved risks.
Record coordination decisions and specialist responsibilities.
Record filed dossier basis and approvals.
Carry permit and design assumptions into tender documents.
Track site decisions and changed assumptions against the ledger.
Close out final evidence and residual warranty/defect obligations.
